facts.label: Rename frees old name
facts.note: Telegram publishes no hold policy - a changed-away username re-enters the public pool fast. Saving an empty username releases yours instantly.

facts.label: Inactivity recycling
facts.note: Telegram reserves the right to recall usernames of unused bots and channels and openly squatted names - no blanket sweeps of personal handles.

facts.label: Deletion frees name
facts.note: Accounts self-destruct after 18 months of inactivity by default; Telegram doesn’t document when the username returns to the pool.

facts.label: Rename cooldown
facts.note: Change your username any time from Settings - no waiting period, no fee.

facts.label: How we check
facts.note: Visible profiles prove taken; Fragment proves auction state and price. Free vs hidden is indistinguishable from outside the app - we say so instead of guessing.

facts.label: Drop outlook
facts.note: Instant releases, a liquid collectibles market (Fragment, on the TON blockchain), and a paid-offer path for taken names - more ways to get a name than any other platform.

facts.label: Rename frees old name
facts.note: Abandoned usernames of non-Partnered accounts take at least 180 days before they can be reclaimed through self-service - no announced date.

facts.label: Inactivity recycling
facts.note: Twitch confirms accounts can be "recycled due to inactivity" (fully deleted, unrecoverable). The once-published 12-month threshold and batch releases date to its 2017 policy announcement; current docs state no period.

facts.label: Deletion frees name
facts.note: Deleted-account logins take a minimum of 6 months to recycle.

facts.label: Rename cooldown
facts.note: One username change per 60 days - blocked during an active broadcast or while a VOD upload is pending; verified email required.

facts.label: How we check
facts.note: Empty result = no active account. Names in the 6-month hold zone can look free before they are claimable - the watch catches the real release.

facts.label: Drop outlook
facts.note: Renames start a datable 6-month clock; recycling waves are rare and never announced. Twitch offers no availability alerts of its own.

facts.label: How we check
